summary: This is a product page for DIY magnetic insect screens sold by a Hong Kong supplier (MagneticScreens Hong Kong). The page promotes window and door magnetic fly screens, custom-made screens, and accessories, with listed prices and claims of quick installation, free delivery across Hong Kong, and durability for homes and businesses. Navigation menus and shop links are boilerplate and were ignored.
one_line: Hong Kong product page selling DIY magnetic window and door insect screens, accessories, and custom-made screens with listed prices.
key_facts: MagneticScreens Hong Kong sells DIY magnetic insect screens for windows and doors.
Magnetic Window Screens are listed from $450.
Magnetic Door Screens are listed from $250.
Extra Magnetic Strip is priced at $60 per metre.
Extra PVC Frame Length is priced at $70 per metre.
Window Flyscreen Accessories Extra Corner Pieces Set (x4 Corners | x2 Wind Clips) is priced at $70.
Fiberglass Flyscreen Mesh is listed at $350 to $500 and is marked as on sale.
The page states that FAST FREE delivery is available all throughout Hong Kong.
The magnetic window screens are designed to keep out mosquitoes, flies, wasps, midges, and other crawling and flying insects.
The screens can be installed directly onto the window frame or surrounding walls, both inside or outside.
The page says the screens will not obstruct the view or block natural light.
The page claims the magnetic window fly screen system is fully compliant with local food agency requirements, making it suitable for hotel kitchens, food manufacturers, and restaurants.
The product page shows a customer rating of 4.84 out of 5 based on 32 customer ratings.
